newsitem.title: LEBANON: Israeli helicopters said to hit in east Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Israeli helicopters said to hit in east Lebanon.

text.p: Security sources in Lebanon said Israeli helicopters fired rockets on Saturday into suspected Hizbollah targets in the Syrian-policed eastern Bekaa valley.
An Israeli army spokesman in Tel Aviv said, however: "There was no air force attack in lebanon."
The Lebanese sources said two helicopters fired four rockets into the village of Libbaya in the western side of the eastern Bekaa valley.
There was no immediate report of casualties.
Israel has mounted two dozen air raids against Lebanon this year.
The last air attack into the eastern Bekaa was on March 20 when Israeli jets rocketed an empty scouts camp for the pro-Iranian Hizbollah near the Syrian border.
Hizbollah guerrillas fight Israeli troops and their local militia allies in a bid to oust them from a 15-km-wide (nine miles) south Lebanon occupation zone.
